title: Mixins into game methods that changed signature: the type, handled
text: The type `mixin target changed signature, game: linked`, read by why each handler did not follow (-Djarport.why): @Injects whose @At names a call the game replaced follow the replacement; handlers with MixinExtras sugar after the CallbackInfo follow when each @Local still finds its parameter unambiguously; conversions read calls with constant arguments and primitives borrow the game's conversion for their type (1.21's tick delta from the DeltaTracker); mixins into the game's lambdas are handed back by intermediary name and read from the game's classes (kept, followed when renumbered, reported when gone and required); nested platform modules are the platform's own and not linked.
finish: the type's finishes and mods counts fall, newest and big-updates up, load on a real server and client where it frees the most
wrongIf: a mod this frees fails in a real game
result: Type finishes 55 -> 51 and appears in 872 -> 853 mod ports (1,292 -> 1,250 references). Every update 6,045 -> 6,051, big updates 1,925 -> 1,931, newest 16. Four updates lower by lambda targets the new release no longer has and the mods require (Language Reload, FastQuit, Mouse Tweaks, VMP). Real Fabric 1.21 client: the newly linked Dynamic FPS passes; a Fabric 1.21 server loads 24 of 25 server-side mods (Terralith's data refused); ported ImmediatelyFast and ReplayMod reach the 1.20.4 title screen where they had crashed on their lambda mixins.
